name: git-insights
description: A project tab with who is working on the project, its latest commits, the files that change most, open pull requests and a few figures, from the clone's git history and GitHub, read again every hour.

refreshMinutes.title: Read again every (minutes)
refreshMinutes.description: How old the figures may get before the plugin reads the history and GitHub again: at least 5, at most 1440.

defaultDays.title: Period shown first
defaultDays.description: How far back people, hotspots and the figures look when the tab opens; the tab can switch.

hotspotIgnore.title: Files left out of hotspots
hotspotIgnore.description: File names (a * matches any part of a name), paths, or folders ending in /. Lock files are left out by default.

includeBots.title: Count bots
includeBots.description: Whether commits and pull requests from bots such as Dependabot count.
